Id.description: The identifier of an existing rule to update. Leave it empty to create a new rule.

Name.description: The display name of the rewrite rule.

Source.description: The rewrite rule source provider name, such as Redirect or Rewrite. The well known members of the rule depend on this value.

Order.description: The order in which the rule is evaluated relative to the other rules. Lower values run first.

items.description: A URL rewrite rule to create or update.

Source.description: Redirect rule. Redirects the incoming request to a new URL and returns the configured redirect status code. Fixed 'Source' for the 'Redirect' rewrite rule source.

Pattern.description: The regular expression matched against the incoming request path, for example ^article/(.*)$.

SubstitutionPattern.description: The replacement URL the matched request is redirected to. It can reference capture groups from the match pattern, such as /blog/$1.

IsCaseInsensitive.description: Whether the match pattern ignores case. Adds the 'NC' Apache mod_rewrite flag when true.

QueryStringPolicy.description: How the original request query string is handled. 'Append' keeps it (QSA flag) and 'Drop' removes it (QSD flag).

RedirectType.description: The HTTP redirect status code returned. 'Found' is 302, 'MovedPermanently' is 301, 'TemporaryRedirect' is 307 and 'PermanentRedirect' is 308.

Source.description: Rewrite rule. Rewrites the incoming request to a new URL server-side without changing the address shown to the client. Fixed 'Source' for the 'Rewrite' rewrite rule source.

Pattern.description: The regular expression matched against the incoming request path, for example ^article/(.*)$.

SubstitutionPattern.description: The replacement URL the matched request is rewritten to. It can reference capture groups from the match pattern, such as /blog/$1.

IsCaseInsensitive.description: Whether the match pattern ignores case. Adds the 'NC' Apache mod_rewrite flag when true.

QueryStringPolicy.description: How the original request query string is handled. 'Append' keeps it (QSA flag) and 'Drop' removes it (QSD flag).

SkipFurtherRules.description: Whether the remaining rules are skipped once this rule matches. Adds the 'L' Apache mod_rewrite flag when true.

Rules.description: The URL rewrite rules to create or update.
